The user gains that Ability until the end of the encounter. • When the user faints, they may grant use of one of their Basic Abilities to an ally on the field for the rest of the encounter.

fields.effect: Choose One Effect: Connection – Teleport. You activate Teleporter as if your Teleporter value were three times its normal value; or you may take one willing adjacent Pokémon or Trainer along with you as you teleport so long as you are touching them when you activate Transporter. You may expend two uses of Transporter at once to choose both effects.
